items.html: These Nekudot are the phase of the kings who ruled in the land of Edom and died. This is also the meaning of, “and the earth [also land] was unformed and void [Heb: Tohu and Bohu].” “Land” is the last Hey, which is the phase of Ayin. She is the one who was Tohu and Bohu [unformed and void], which is the matter of the death of the kings until their correction arrived. At that time, it was said, “Let there be light, and there was light.” This is also, “Open your eyes, and see our desolation.”
